summary: Ardelyx filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, reporting that Chief Commercial Officer Eric Foster resigned on August 11, 2026, effective August 28, 2026. No reason given beyond pursuing a new opportunity at a pre-commercial company; no disagreement cited. This is an abrupt senior executive departure disclosed via Item 8.01, not a routine meeting or proxy matter. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors mentioned. Watch for successor announcement or any strategic impact on commercial operations.
